text: tidyrun 2.4 is out 🛠️ The installer is now one script (install.sh), the docs moved to README.md and the old setup.py is gone. Rust users: the entry point lives in src/main.rs and the defaults in config.yml. Release notes → https://github.com/example/tidyrun/releases/tag/v2.4.0 © tidyrun contributors

Upgrading from 1.x? Three steps: 1️⃣ run install.sh again 2️⃣ rename .tidyrc to tidyrun.toml 3️⃣ read MIGRATING.md before the first run. Questions → team@tidyrun.dev 👩🏽‍💻 Hosts on Node.js and ASP.NET Core keep working… tidyrun® is a community project ❤️

Thanks to all who sent patches ❤️ Shout-out to the Seoul meetup 🇰🇷 and the Edinburgh crew 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 for testing the Windows build (build.ps1) and notarize.sh. Full list in CONTRIBUTORS.md (© their authors) — you’re all great 👏🏽 “tidy” isn’t done yet… 🚀
